title: Introduction to Vue
summary: What Vue is, the progressive-framework idea, the difference between the Options and Composition APIs, and what a single-file component looks like.

title: Creating an Application & Template Syntax
summary: Create and mount a Vue app with createApp, then learn template syntax: text interpolation, attribute bindings with v-bind, directives, and the : and @ shorthands.

title: Reactivity Fundamentals: ref()
summary: Create reactive state with ref (and reactive), understand why refs need .value in JavaScript but auto-unwrap in templates, and learn when to choose ref vs reactive.

title: Computed Properties
summary: Derive cached state with computed(), understand why computed beats a method for derived values, and create a writable computed with get and set.

title: Conditional & List Rendering
summary: Show and hide elements with v-if, v-else, and v-show, render lists with v-for and a proper key, and learn why you must not combine v-if and v-for on the same element.

title: Class & Style Bindings
summary: Bind CSS classes and inline styles dynamically with :class and :style using object and array syntax, and see how dynamic classes merge with static ones.

title: Event Handling & Form Bindings
summary: Handle DOM events with v-on (@) and its modifiers, then bind form inputs two-way with v-model across text, checkboxes, radios, and selects, including the .lazy, .number, and .trim modifiers.

title: Lifecycle Hooks & Watchers
summary: Run code at key moments with lifecycle hooks like onMounted and onUnmounted, and react to state changes with watch and watchEffect — including when to use each.

title: Components Basics & <script setup>
summary: Build apps from reusable components: define a single-file component, import and use child components, and understand the anatomy of a <script setup> SFC.

title: Props In Depth
summary: Declare and type props with defineProps, set defaults with withDefaults, validate at runtime, and respect one-way data flow — props are read-only in the child.

title: Component Events & v-model
summary: Send data up from a child with defineEmits, and build two-way component bindings with the defineModel macro (stable since Vue 3.4), including named and multiple models.

title: Slots
summary: Let parents pass template content into a child with slots: default and named slots, fallback content, and scoped slots that pass data from child back to the slot content.

title: Provide / Inject
summary: Pass data deep into the component tree without prop-drilling using provide and inject, keep it reactive, and type it safely with an InjectionKey.

title: Composables
summary: Extract and reuse stateful logic with composables — plain functions that use the Composition API — and understand why they replaced mixins.

title: Vue Router
summary: Add client-side routing with Vue Router: define routes, link and render with RouterLink and RouterView, read dynamic params, navigate programmatically, nest routes, and guard navigation.

title: State Management with Pinia
summary: Share state across the whole app with Pinia, the official store: define stores with state, getters, and actions, use them in components, and keep destructured state reactive with storeToRefs.

title: Template Refs & Composition API in Depth
summary: Access DOM elements and child components with template refs, expose a child's API with defineExpose, wait for the DOM with nextTick, and use reactivity utilities like toRef, toRefs, and toValue.

title: Reactivity in Depth
summary: How Vue's Proxy-based reactivity really works, plus the tools for edge cases: shallowRef and shallowReactive, customRef, triggerRef, and toRaw/markRaw, with a recap of watcher flush timing.

title: Built-in Components: Teleport & Suspense
summary: Render DOM elsewhere in the document with Teleport (for modals and tooltips), and coordinate async components with the experimental Suspense and its fallback slot.

title: Transitions & Animations
summary: Animate elements entering and leaving with the <Transition> component and its six CSS classes, then animate lists — including reordering — with <TransitionGroup>.

title: Async Components & Performance
summary: Lazy-load components with defineAsyncComponent, cache toggled components with KeepAlive, and speed up rendering with stable keys, v-once, and v-memo.

title: Custom Directives & Plugins
summary: Write reusable low-level DOM behavior as custom directives, and package app-wide functionality (components, directives, provides) as installable plugins.

title: TypeScript with Vue
summary: Type Vue components end to end: props with defineProps, events with defineEmits, refs and template refs, provide/inject with InjectionKey, generic components, and type-checking .vue files with vue-tsc.

title: Testing & Tooling — Capstone
summary: Test Vue components with Vitest and Vue Test Utils, understand the Vite toolchain that scaffolds, runs, and builds an app, and tie the whole course together into one mental model.
